office_does: The County Coroner investigates sudden, unexpected, violent or unnatural deaths in Yakima County, oversees autopsies and may testify in court about a death.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Coroner Marshall Slight (Prefers Republican Party), appointed in 2025 and elected in a 2025 special election, is the only candidate for the full term.

candidates.summary: Yakima County Coroner since his 2025 appointment and chief deputy coroner from 2009; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Chief deputy coroner 2009-2025; appointed coroner in May 2025 after his predecessor resigned [S1][S2]
Won the November 2025 special election with about 70% in election-night returns [S3]
Names aging vehicles and equipment and a tight $600,000 budget as the office's main problems [S2]
